title: Дослідницьке робоче місце джерела
fields_and_relations: Дозволені тексти/медіа й локатори, паралельні версії, власні примітки.
required_interaction: Анотувати range/segment; джерело не змінюється, offset прив’язаний до revision.

implementation.view_model: Exact source reader, authorized transcript/media/timed hit, context traversal and provenance/verification before selection
limitations: Local synchronous discovery over permitted browser data; no server search index or vector embeddings.
Context matching uses explicit active-term aliases and one-hop broader/narrower/reviewed related mappings, with visible reasons.
Map uses bundled Natural Earth land and only explicitly allowed, finite coordinates; no address geocoder or external map requests.
Candidate basket belongs to this browser tab and is rechecked before handover; reproducible archival membership is recorded by the WF-16 corpus wizard.
Parallel transcription/media editing, segment annotations and multiple evidence workflows remain WF-17/18.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; existing user state is preserved, new grants require explicit human review.
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
implementation.subject_access: Before search, counts, facets, snippets and playback: scoped domain.read, exact O47 research/view, time/embargo/consent checks, unmasked context fields and exact resource grants. Revoked resources disappear. Cite/download remain separate.
